action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy allows exchange of delivered order items for available variants of the same product with user confirmation, correct payment method, and explicit confirmation of all details.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User confirmed the exact item to exchange, the new configuration, the price difference, and the payment method. Assistant presented all details and obtained explicit confirmation before writing.
